prompts.forest: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-bleed watercolor background for Trailbound's interactive 2D hiking game, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. Primary request: a quiet sheltered subtropical woodland edge on the uphill walking trail from Ham Tin Wan towards Tai Long Au, Hong Kong Sai Kung, early afternoon, no people and no birds painted into the background because animated birds will be separate layers. Fine traditional watercolor travel-journal painting on textured cotton paper, richly detailed natural foliage, restrained fern green, warm ivory light, blue-gray distant hills and a small glimpse of turquoise coastal water at upper center. A narrow worn rock-and-earth footpath curves gently uphill from lower center towards the upper-left background, not a yellow running track. Open peaceful air across the middle. Include three thin naturally curved perching branches with clear empty space immediately above each, near normalized centers (0.22,0.49), (0.50,0.38), (0.78,0.51), all inside central 70% of image so touch targets can fit on a phone. Organic grouped broadleaf shrubs and grasses, gentle dappled sunlight, no pine forest, bamboo jungle or tropical palms. Detailed, tactile, calm, unified with fine watercolor coastal scenery. Fill the entire rectangular canvas. No text, no symbols, no UI, no borders, no extra animals, no badge.
prompts.birds: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024, for three stylized small woodland songbirds in a quiet fine watercolor hiking game. Draw three distinct birds in three equal columns in the TOP half only, centered x=256,768,1280 and y=250, with plenty of transparent space between them and transparent bottom half. Each bird fits within a 340x360 rectangle, perched upright, visible tiny feet and tail, natural compact proportions, detailed watercolor feathers and delicate pencil outlines on paper-like texture. Bird at left: olive green back, creamy chest, soft dark eye stripe, facing right. Center: warm ochre brown upperparts and pale belly, facing slightly left. Right: slate blue-gray back and warm white belly, facing left. These are fictional stylized woodland birds, do not imitate cartoon mascots. Beaks gently open as if calling. No branch, no ground, no environment, no shadows outside bodies, no written labels, no icons, no circles. Actual fully transparent background. Muted organic colors, no neon, fine layered watercolor with feather detail; do not make photorealistic, plastic or 3D.
prompts.badge: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: collectible circular hand-painted travel-journal badge, square 1024x1024 with a transparent background. Primary request: a fine watercolor round medallion for a coastal hiking memory called woodland echo, no text. One naturally small olive-and-cream songbird perched on a delicate branch with a few muted green leaves in foreground, slender slate blue-gray bird further back, Tai Long Au's green coastal hills and a tiny turquoise glimpse of the sea behind, warm dappled afternoon sunshine, exquisite watercolor pigment granulation and paper texture, peaceful. Entire artwork contained within one clean circular medallion, thin understated antique warm-gold double rim with a tiny simple four-point star at the top and bottom like Trailbound travel-journal badges, no heavy shiny 3D frame. Main circle centered with diameter 92% of canvas, outside truly transparent. Full detailed circular interior, no written words, no letters, no numbers, no UI. Coherent with hand-painted coastal landscape and round crab collectible in the same game.
prompts.forest-phone: Create a new PORTRAIT 2:3 watercolor composition of the same quiet coastal woodland hiking scene shown in the reference. Output 1024x1536. Preserve its fine layered watercolor, warm dappled daylight, natural broadleaf shrubs, stone-and-earth uphill path, blue-gray Sai Kung coastal hills and distant turquoise bay. This is a dedicated phone game background, not a stretched or letterboxed landscape. Full bleed portrait painting. No birds and no people, because three animated bird sprites will be overlaid later. The footpath runs from bottom left up into the shaded upper-left woodland. Keep three clear perching branches at exact normalized positions: upper LEFT branch perch at (0.22,0.29); lower CENTER perch at (0.50,0.72); middle RIGHT perch at (0.78,0.48). Each perch is a thin, naturally attached branch with open air above it for a small bird body. Keep these small perch areas visually clear. Left foliage frames the trail; leaves, ferns and stones are finely painted, rich pigment texture on paper. Let the bay and sky occupy the upper third through the trees. No pine alpine forest, palms, tropical jungle, text, UI, captions, watermark, borders or extra animals. Match the original watercolor palette and texture. Portrait composition must fill the whole image.

edits.birds: Preserve the exact birds, positions and dimensions; remove all outer colored haze and shadows, leave every pixel outside the bird silhouettes fully transparent.
